top_signals.title: Oil Prices Lower as Focus Shifts to Middle East Supply
top_signals.summary: Oil prices declined on Tuesday as investors focused on signs of recovering crude exports from the Middle East and lingering concerns over potential supply disruptions in the region stemming from the US-Israeli war on Iran.Brent crude futures were down $1.96…

top_signals.title: How Abu Dhabi's Crown Prince Is Trying to Bypass Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed Al Nahyan took the helm of a $300 billion sovereign wealth fund which has become central to building the infrastructure needed to override Iran’s stranglehold over the Strait of Hormuz. The fund is now likely to spend tens of billions of dollars more on new port infrastructure outside the embattled strait, people familiar with the matter said. Bloomberg's Alex Dooler reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
